Compute the number-average molecular weight M_n for the given polymer sample using the formula M_n = Σ(N_i · M_i) / Σ(N_i), where N_i is the count listed in parentheses and M_i is the corresponding molecular weight in g/mol.
Identify the four (M_i, N_i) pairs: (56526, 96), (92809, 131), (115856, 153), (126029, 146).
Calculate Σ(N_i · M_i) = 96·56526 + 131·92809 + 153·115856 + 146·126029 = 5,426,496 + 12,157,979 + 17,725,968 + 18,400,234 = 53,710,677.
Calculate Σ(N_i) = 96 + 131 + 153 + 146 = 526.
Compute M_n = 53,710,677 / 526 ≈ 102,111.6 g/mol.
Report the result to an appropriate number of significant figures: M_n ≈ 1.02 × 10^5 g/mol (or 102,112 g/mol).
